    Neighborhood: 53705

    • Community Vibe
      Residents enjoy a strong sense of community, with local events and gatherings fostering connections among neighbors.
    • Dining Scene
      A variety of restaurants and cafes offer diverse culinary experiences, from casual bites to fine dining.
    • Family Vibes
      The neighborhood features numerous parks and playgrounds, perfect for family outings and outdoor activities.
    • Nature Views
      The area's proximity to Lake Mendota and scenic parks provides stunning natural views and recreational opportunities.

    The 53705 area offers a blend of vibrant community life and picturesque scenery, with its tree-lined streets and proximity to Lake Mendota. Renters can expect a median rent of around $1,800, with prices ranging from $1,200 to $2,500. The neighborhood boasts an array of local amenities, including charming coffee shops like Michelangelo's Coffee House, diverse dining options, and outdoor spaces such as the nearby University of Wisconsin-Madison Arboretum. Families will appreciate the parks and playgrounds, while pet owners can enjoy the area's pet-friendly spaces. The cultural scene is enriched by local art galleries and theaters, making it a lively place to call home.

    Frequently asked questions

    What is the walk score of EO Madison Yards?

    EO Madison Yards has a walk score of 79, it's very walkable.

    What is the transit score of EO Madison Yards?

    EO Madison Yards has a transit score of 46, it has some transit.

    What schools are assigned to EO Madison Yards?

    The schools assigned to EO Madison Yards include Van Hise Elementary School, Hamilton Middle School, and West High School.

    Does EO Madison Yards have in-unit laundry?

    Yes, EO Madison Yards has in-unit laundry for some or all of the units.

    What neighborhood is EO Madison Yards in?

    EO Madison Yards is in the 53705 neighborhood in Madison, WI.

    What are EO Madison Yards's policies on pets?

    A maximum of 2 cats are allowed per unit. This building has monthly fee of $25 for cats. A maximum of 2 dogs are allowed per unit. This building has monthly fee of $50 for dogs.
